QUI_SOMMES_NOUS.DESCRIPTION_PAGE: The story, values and area of action of the Chance De Vivre-Togo NGO.
QUI_SOMMES_NOUS.HISTOIRE_TEXTE: Chance De Vivre-Togo is an NGO based in Tsévié, in the Maritime Region of Togo. For several years, it has carried out concrete actions for education, health and local economic development, alongside Togolese communities.
QUI_SOMMES_NOUS.VALEUR_SOLIDARITE_TEXTE: Acting alongside communities, with them and for them.
QUI_SOMMES_NOUS.VALEUR_TRANSPARENCE_TEXTE: Being accountable to our partners and the public for our actions.
QUI_SOMMES_NOUS.VALEUR_IMPACT_TEXTE: Favouring actions that durably improve everyday life.
QUI_SOMMES_NOUS.ZONE_TEXTE: Our actions take place in several localities of Togo: Tsévié (Maritime Region), Agbonou and Anié (Plateaux Region), as well as the Kara Region.
